newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK forwarders to choose new chairman on April 29.
newsitem.headline: HK forwarders to choose new chairman on April 29.

text.p: The Hong Kong Association of Freight Forwarding Agents (HAFFA) will elect a new chairman at its annual general meeting on April 29 following the resignation of its current chairman, Sam Chung.
Chung told Reuters he is standing down because he has left Fritz Air Freight (HK) where he was general manager and company director. He declined to give a reason.
"I can't say anything to you at the moment but I am looking for a new job," Chung said. He had held the post for a year and was also chairman in 1980.
Chung will attend the meeting to receive an award of appreciation for his services to HAFFA, an association source said.
All 260 HAFFA members vote to chose the committee which then decides on the attribution of the different posts. The current vice chairman is Baltrans Ltd chairman, Anthony Lau.

Four committee members who have served for four years are standing down under HAFFA's rules including its honorary secretary, Bengt Sjoeberg of ASG (HK) Ltd. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
